This app is a search tool, like a web browser. It hosts no book, stores no catalogue and keeps no account: every search goes straight from your phone to the site you chose, and every file comes straight from that site to your phone.

Copyright differs by country. In Switzerland and in the European Union a text is free seventy years after its author's death; in the United States, in Canada and elsewhere the rules differ, so a book that a foreign site offers freely may still be protected where you are. When a site tells the author's dates, the app says whether the seventy years have passed; otherwise it says nothing, and the decision is yours.

By using this app you undertake to download only what you have the right to download where you are: public-domain texts, freely licensed texts, and copies of books you own where the law allows it. You alone are responsible for what you download. The author of this app takes no part in your searches, has no knowledge of them and accepts no liability for them.

Nothing is sent anywhere but to the sites you search. No statistics, no tracking, no logs.

Anna\'s Archive is a shadow library: it indexes Library Genesis, Z-Library and other collections, most of which hold copyrighted books, and courts have ordered its domains blocked. Ticking a box does not change the law. Turn it on only if you will use it for files you have the right to download: public-domain texts, open-access publications, or a copy of a book you own where your law allows it. Its pages are read by the app exactly as a browser would; a browser check may appear, and a download waits for the site\'s countdown.
